nodes.title: Expected number of events

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a square-integrable real random variable on a probability space with $\mathbb E X \neq 0$. Then On the event $X = 0$ one has $|X - \mathbb E X| = |\mathbb E X|$, so this is Chebyshev's inequality at distance $|\mathbb E X|$. Consequently, if $\operatorname{Var} X = o((\mathbb E X)^2)$ along a sequence, then $X \neq 0$ with high probability; for a nonnegative count this means that some counted event occurs.
